Why it matters: pushed Ethosoft to evaluate its own work by usability and real-world fit, not technical performance alone.

Expanded account

Success measured beyond technical performance.

The Başakşehir Living Lab Innovation Competition asked a pointed question: can a technology project's success be measured by technical performance alone? The competition's judging emphasized the value a solution delivers to its users, its level of innovation, how workable it is in practice, and how well it maps onto a real-world counterpart—not benchmark numbers in isolation.

Ethosoft placed second in Türkiye, and the competition reinforced a standard the team carried into later, more research-oriented work: usefulness and real-world fit matter alongside technical strength.
